english:
[Timothy] 3:1. "My child, [be strong] in the grace..." to verse 6. "...lest he fall into condemnation."
Prophet Jeremiah 17:7. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 8. "...from yielding fruit."
The Apostle 2 Timothy 2:3. "Share in suffering..." to verse 10. "...with eternal glory."
Alleluia of the martyrs, in the tone of the day.
Gospel Matthew 19:27. "Then answered [Peter]..." to verse 29. "...and shall inherit [eternal life]."

[Note on liturgical variations:]
When there are eight weeks in this interval, you shall celebrate the feasts of this week in order as they are set down.
But if there are seven weeks, celebrate the feast of Severianus along with the Hyperichians.
And on Thursday, celebrate John Chrysostom.
And on Saturday, celebrate the feast of All Saints without fail, as the Calendar shows you.

Tuesday. Of the Holy Hyperichians, who were martyred in Samosata.
Patristic [Hymn] of the Martyrs.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 115 [116:15]. "Precious [in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints]."
Proverbs 12:8. "A man shall be commended according to his wisdom..." to verse 13. "...but the just shall escape out of trouble."
Prophet Isaiah 49:8. "Thus says the Lord to Israel..." to verse 11. "...in their pastures."
The Apostle 2 Corinthians 4:6. "For God, who commanded..." to verse 14. "...with you."
Alleluia of the martyrs, in the tone of the day.
Gospel Luke 10:21. "In that hour..." to verse 24. "...and have not heard them."

Wednesday. Patristic [Hymn] of Repentance.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 85 [86:16]. "Save the son of thy handmaid."
The Apostle Galatians 5:16. "But I say this..." to verse 26. "...envying one another."
Alleluia of the fast, in the tone of the day.
Gospel Luke 7:36. "And one of [the Pharisees] desired him..." to verse 48. "...Your sins are forgiven."

Thursday. Of the Holy Severianus of Sebastia, Babylas the Elder, and his eighty-four disciples.
Patristic [Hymn] of the Martyrs.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 131 [132:9]. "Let thy priests [be clothed with righteousness]."
Proverbs 15:27 [16:6 / 15:32]. "By mercy..." to verse 22 [15:32]. "...gets understanding."
Prophet Isaiah 66:18. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 21. "...for Levites, says the Lord."
Catholic [Epistle] 1 John 2:7. "Beloved, I write no [new commandment]..." to verse 11. "...his eyes."
Alleluia of the martyrs, in the tone of the day.
Gospel John 16:1. "These things have I spoken..." to verse 4. "...I was with you."

Friday. Patristic [Hymn] of Rest.
Midday Liturgy Psalm 97 [98:3]. "All [the ends of the earth] have seen."
The Apostle Galatians 6:1. "Brethren, if a man be overtaken..." to verse 13. "...they may glory."
Alleluia of the fast, in the tone of the day.
Gospel Luke 8:4. "And when much people were gathered..." to verse 16. "...they which enter in may see the light."

Saturday. Of Holy John Chrysostom, Patriarch.
Canticle Tone 1 [ak]: "Those who adorned" (Որք զարդարեցին), with its proper canons.
Magnificat Tone 6 [gk]: "Who from the unoriginate Father" (Որ յանսկիզբն ի հօրէ).
Midday Liturgy Hymn Tone 3 [gz]: "The Leaders" (Զառաջնորդս).
Psalm 14 [15:4]. "Them that fear the Lord."
Prophet Isaiah 49:1. "Listen, O isles, unto me..." to verse 6. "...of Israel."
Acts 20:25. "And now, behold..." to verse 38. "...unto the ship."
Alleluia. "You are a priest."
Gospel John 15:17. "These things I command you..." to verse 25. "...without a cause."

Eighth Sunday after the Holy Cross.
Patristic [Hymn] Tone 8 [dk]: "Who the all-powerful" (Որ զամենազօր).
Magnificat. "Mother of God, Virgin and Mother."
Midday Liturgy Psalm 64 [65:1]. "Praise is due to thee."
Prophet Isaiah 22:15. "Thus says the Lord of hosts..." to verse 25. "...in that day."
The Apostle Ephesians 1:1. "Paul, an apostle..." to verse 14. "...unto his glory."
Alleluia, in the tone of the day.
Gospel Luke 8:17. "For nothing is secret..." to verse 21. "...hear [the word of God] and do it."

Monday. Of the Holy Stephen, Patriarch of Rome, and his Priests, Deacons, and People.
Patristic [Hymn] of the Martyrs.
Magnificat Tone 7 [dz]: "Today [the Church] rejoices" (Ցնծայ այսօր).
Evening Dismissal Tone 6 [gk]: "Martyr and witness" (Մարտիրոս եւ վկայ).
Midday Liturgy Hymn Tone 3 [gz]: "The Leaders" (Զառաջնորդս).
Psalm 131 [132:9]. "Thy priests."
Proverbs Wisdom 5:1. "Then shall the righteous man stand..." to verse 8. "...profitable."
Prophet Amos 3:12. "Thus says the Lord..." to verse 15. "...shall fall, says the Lord."
The Apostle Ephesians 4:1 [3:1]. "For this cause I Paul..." to verse 10 [3:10]. "...the wisdom of God."
Alleluia. "Thy priests."
Gospel John 10:11. "I am the good shepherd..." to verse 16. "...and one shepherd."

Tuesday. Of the Holy Bishop Acipisimas, the Priest Joseph, the Deacon Aithalas, and the Martyr Plato.
Patristic [Hymn] of the Martyrs.
Midday Liturgy
